task_text: Follow the directive **"put exactly 1 red object in the box"**. Success: the box holds exactly one red object, and no object of another colour. An object is in the box when its centre is inside the box's interior (between its walls, below the lid); the count is read anew at every step, so taking an object out again, or dropping in one too many, undoes it. The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
